questions.question: When should assembly control freeze a force-sensor calibration update so that genuine contact is not absorbed as bias?
questions.changed_decision: Trust/freeze calibration or perform a bounded retreat/reorientation; not generic contact-mode prediction.
questions.learning_mechanism: Small history-conditioned update-validity gate / uncertainty estimator
questions.strongest_rival: Known-payload Kalman estimator with contact-threshold gating and matched bounded motion
questions.falsifier: Learning gain disappears under matched classical gating, or bias/contact remain observationally indistinguishable without additional information.
questions.resource_entry: Previously frozen robosuite state/wrench interface; observation-bias/contact wrapper is a proposed reviewed extension, not validated real sensor physics.
questions.independent_unit: Assembly episode grouped by payload/contact/bias family

questions.question: When actuator limits are reached, does a flight controller need reference modification rather than further parameter adaptation?
questions.changed_decision: Continue adaptation or invoke reference governor/retiming; not separate wind from rotor lag.
questions.strongest_rival: Matched geometric/INDI control with anti-windup and model-based reference governor or constrained MPC
questions.falsifier: A deterministic feasibility rule matches recovery/tracking; apparent gain uses unequal reference preview/tuning or a trajectory even oracle parameters cannot track.
questions.resource_entry: Official gym-pybullet-drones examples; required motor/actuator model not assumed complete. RS-FAIR implementation uses IsaacSim/IsaacLab, not demonstrated CPU reproduction.
questions.independent_unit: Complete flight grouped by vehicle-parameter/reference family

questions.question: When sender timestamps are uncertain, when should a mobile robot stop trusting a stale peer-state prediction?
questions.changed_decision: Use prediction, reachable-set fallback, waiting or request fresher message; not load-conditioned traffic guidance.
questions.strongest_rival: Interval clock correction plus physical reachable-set/priority control
questions.falsifier: Timestamp perturbations do not change outcomes under honest local sensing, or interval prediction/waiting removes the effect without learning.
questions.resource_entry: RVO2 C++ CPU-oriented baseline and MACBF-GNN public entry points; clock/acceleration wrapper not stock validated scenario.
questions.independent_unit: Joint robot scenario/network trace, not each interacting robot

kill_rules: Classical same-information/action baseline matches the learned tradeoff
Apparent advantage uses hidden truth, unequal data or extra probes/preview
Only fixing released-code/paper differences explains the advantage
An exact nearest-work mechanism covers the intended claim
Available observations/actions cannot disambiguate the proposed physical causes
Required physical sensor-drift/contact data or runner resources are unavailable
pilot_preparation.minimum_publishable_condition: A nontrivial source-checked incremental scientific result after strong matched physical baselines; not a source-code fix, guessed gap or isolated simulation success
pilot_preparation.merge_condition: Estimator, activation gate, calibration boundary and its assembly demonstration may be one scientific contribution; do not split them into several independent papers
pilot_preparation.backup_rule: Archive complete outcomes/failed attempts/registered comparisons outside the paper; keep interpretation-changing evidence available without reproducing all logs
